title: Campaign reasoning persistence (study CoT + measure redaction)

locked_decisions.shape: A — per-LLM-call list on answer row
locked_decisions.scope: B3 — SQL + RAG + routing campaign answer paths
locked_decisions.defaults: B4 — both persist_eval_reasoning_text and persist_eval_reasoning_raw default true
locked_decisions.row_shape: A — reasoning_calls: [{i, reasoning_text, reasoning_text_raw, sha256, char_count}, ...]
locked_decisions.config: A — Settings defaults on; freeze/campaign may override off

observable_outcome: Every campaign answer row written via sanitize_answer_rows_for_persistence includes reasoning_calls when the model returned reasoning on one or more LLM calls in that cell. Each call entry has full (untruncated) reasoning_text_raw and reasoning_text=redact_secrets(raw). Defaults: persist_eval_reasoning_text=true and persist_eval_reasoning_raw=true. When either flag is false, that body field is stripped (sha256/char_count metadata may remain). SQL CapturingCallback records per-call evidence; RAG and routing paths attach the same list shape before sanitize. Prod Ask responses and Reasoning Replay wire behavior unchanged.
non_goals: Do not persist reasoning into production Ask / query logs / user-visible answers
Do not commit answers.jsonl containing reasoning_text_raw into git
Do not change Reasoning Replay (tool-loop wire preservation) or strip/replay rules
Do not truncate reasoning bodies in this slice
Do not apply SQL _scrub to reasoning_text (secrets redaction only)
Do not claim ACCEPTED from unit tests alone — live matrix optional after unit green

examples.given: SQL run_case LLM call returns additional_kwargs.reasoning_content='secret sk-test and plan'
examples.expect: row.reasoning_calls[0].reasoning_text_raw contains full text; reasoning_text has secrets redacted; sha256 of raw present; no truncation
persisted row has no reasoning_text / reasoning_text_raw bodies in reasoning_calls (metadata ok)

examples.given: LLM calls with no reasoning fields
examples.expect: reasoning_calls is [] or omitted consistently (pin one); not a fake empty string entry

examples.given: RAG and routing finalize paths write answers.jsonl
examples.expect: same reasoning_calls shape and sanitize rules as SQL

edge_cases: Multi-call SQL tool loop: one reasoning_calls entry per LLM end with evidence
Clarify loop: calls before and after oracle reply both captured when present
Empty reasoning string: do not invent content; skip or record empty per pinned rule (pin: skip empty)
Huge bodies: no truncate — artifact size is accepted cost for study runs
independent_oracle: Known redact_secrets behavior on a planted secret token
Settings defaults true/true; override false strips bodies
acceptance_criteria: Unit: CapturingCallback (or shared collector) extracts per-call evidence into reasoning_calls
Unit: sanitize keeps/strips bodies per dual flags; redacted field uses redact_secrets; raw untouched by redact
Unit: SQL run_case row includes reasoning_calls before/after sanitize under defaults
Unit: RAG + routing persistence paths apply same sanitize to reasoning_calls
